thread:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — we need criteria for scouting hybrid (cloud + on-prem) design partners. Aim: 6 partners, 4-week onboarding, 6-week feedback runway. Keep intake light.
Priya Singh: Love it. Can we use a 4-factor score + two hard gates? Keep scoring 1-5.
Omar Li: Proposed scoring: product fit (30%), infra readiness (30%), feedback capacity (25%), commercial signal (15%).
Grace Adler: Hard gates: (1) partner can start pilot within 45 days, (2) no blocking legal clauses. Both must be yes.
Theo Mendez: For infra readiness, prefer partners with at least single-GPU and ephemeral staging. If not, low score. I'll make a single-GPU runbook.
Maria Chen: Recruitment copy idea: "Hybrid pilot: 6w feedback + 1w integration. Weekly async updates + 1x biweekly review. Incentive: infra credit or co-marketing." Keep concise.
Priya Singh: Feedback loop: weekly slate (short notes) + biweekly 60m deep-dive. Require partner to assign 1 product + 1 eng.
Omar Li: Success metrics suggestion: engagement >= 70% sessions, >=6 actionable issues/partner in first 6w, 1 conversion to reserved within 90d, no critical SLO breaches tied to pilot.
Grace Adler: Add simple eval harness (25 prompts) partners run monthly. Automated diffs to catch regressions.
Theo Mendez: Ops: tag partner infra, create alert channel, and add 72h response SLA for sev-1 from partner. infra-bot can auto-create channels.
legal-bot: Reminder: include pilot addendum template covering data retention, logs, rollback. I'll post draft.
Maria Chen: Owners/timebox: Theo — runbook (EOW); Priya — outreach + intake form (Tue); Omar — rubric sheet + seed scoring (Tue). Reconvene Thu 10am to finalize list. Post short updates in thread. :thumbsup:
